19.7k Master's degrees in United Kingdom

When considering programmes in the United Kingdom, it's important to be aware of the range of tuition fees you might encounter. The lower-end tuition fee, represented by €5,901, offers a more affordable option for students. On the other hand, the higher-end tuition fee, indicated by €46,391, reflects the costlier programmes available. The typical tuition fee, shown by €24,700, provides a middle ground for what most students can expect to pay. It's also worth noting that 1% of programmes in the UK are considered affordable, making higher education accessible to a broader range of students. Additionally, 17% of programmes are offered online, providing flexibility for those who may not be able to attend classes in person.
